suites.name: Smoke
suites.description: Critical paths only. Shallow and wide. Target under 10 minutes. Run on every deploy.

suites.name: Regression
suites.description: Every UI case. Run nightly and before a release.

suites.name: Full Cycle
suites.description: Regression UI suite plus the Bruno API suite and the evidence documents. Run at the end of a sprint.

cases.title: Sign in with the demo admin account

steps.step: [UI] Open the Sign in page
steps.expect: The Sign in form shows the Email and Password fields

steps.step: [UI] Enter login@demo.com and Logindemo123, then select Sign in
steps.expect: The admin Dashboard opens and the header shows Demo Admin

cases.title: Wrong password shows an error

steps.step: [UI] Open the Sign in page
steps.expect: The Sign in form shows

steps.step: [UI] Enter login@demo.com with a wrong password, then select Sign in
steps.expect: The alert says "Invalid email or password." and the user stays signed out

cases.title: Invalid email format is rejected

steps.step: [UI] Open the Sign in page
steps.expect: The Sign in form shows

steps.step: [UI] Enter "not-an-email" and any password, then select Sign in
steps.expect: The Email field shows "Enter a valid email address."

cases.title: Disabled account cannot sign in

steps.step: [UI] Open the Sign in page
steps.expect: The Sign in form shows

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as budi@demo.com (disabled account)
steps.expect: The alert says "This account is disabled. Contact support."

cases.title: Register a new customer account

steps.step: [UI] Open Create account
steps.expect: The registration form shows four fields

steps.step: [UI] Enter a unique qa-auto email, a valid name and a valid password twice, then submit
steps.expect: The Sign in page shows "Account created. Sign in to continue." with the email filled in

steps.step: [UI] Sign in with the new account
steps.expect: The Shop page opens and the header shows the new name

cases.title: Register with an existing email is rejected

steps.step: [UI] Open Create account
steps.expect: The registration form shows

steps.step: [UI] Register with customer@demo.com
steps.expect: The Email field shows "An account with this email already exists."

cases.title: Weak password is rejected

steps.step: [UI] Open Create account
steps.expect: The registration form shows

steps.step: [UI] Register with the password "short"
steps.expect: The Password field shows "Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers."

cases.title: Sign out ends the session

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as customer@demo.com
steps.expect: The header shows Sari Wulandari and Sign out

steps.step: [UI] Select Sign out
steps.expect: The header shows Sign in

steps.step: [UI] Open My orders by its address
steps.expect: The Sign in page opens instead

cases.title: A protected page asks for sign in, then returns to it

steps.step: [UI] Open the Cart page while signed out
steps.expect: The Sign in page opens

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as customer@demo.com
steps.expect: The Cart page opens

cases.title: Shop lists all active products and hides drafts

steps.step: [UI] Open the Shop page
steps.expect: The count shows "11 products"

steps.step: [UI] Look for the draft product Anniversary Jacket
steps.expect: Anniversary Jacket is not in the list

cases.title: Search finds a product by name

steps.step: [UI] Search the shop for "mug"
steps.expect: The count shows "1 product" and the card is Ceramic Coffee Mug

cases.title: Category filter shows only that category

steps.step: [UI] Choose the category Home
steps.expect: The count shows "3 products" and every card says Home

cases.title: Sort by price from low to high

steps.step: [UI] Choose "Price: low to high"
steps.expect: The first card is Spicy Cassava Chips at Rp 25.000

cases.title: Search with no result shows an empty state

steps.step: [UI] Search the shop for "zzzz"
steps.expect: The page shows "No products match your search" and a Clear filters link

cases.title: Product detail shows the price and stock

steps.step: [UI] Open Lawak Classic Tee from the shop
steps.expect: The page shows the name, Rp 149.000 and "In stock"

cases.title: Out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart

steps.step: [UI] Open Bucket Hat
steps.expect: The page shows "Out of stock" and the button is disabled

cases.title: Add a product to the cart

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as a new qa-auto customer and open Ceramic Coffee Mug
steps.expect: The cart count in the header is 0

steps.step: [UI] Select Add to cart
steps.expect: The message says "Added to cart." and the cart count is 1

cases.title: Changing the quantity updates the totals

steps.step: [UI] Add Lawak Classic Tee to the cart and open the cart
steps.expect: Subtotal is Rp 149.000, shipping is Rp 15.000

steps.step: [UI] Increase the quantity to 2
steps.expect: Subtotal is Rp 298.000 and total is Rp 313.000

cases.title: Shipping is free from Rp 300.000

steps.step: [UI] Add Batik Pattern Hoodie (Rp 329.000) and open the cart
steps.expect: Shipping shows "Free" and total is Rp 329.000

cases.title: Removing the last item shows an empty cart

steps.step: [UI] Add Canvas Tote Bag and open the cart
steps.expect: The cart shows one line

steps.step: [UI] Select Remove
steps.expect: The page shows "Your cart is empty" and the cart count is 0

cases.title: Quantity limit of 10 is enforced

steps.step: [UI] Add Jasmine Scented Candle and open the cart
steps.expect: The line shows quantity 1

steps.step: [UI] Type 11 in the quantity box
steps.expect: The alert says "Quantity must be 1 to 10." and the quantity stays 1

cases.title: Checkout with the test card creates an order

steps.step: [UI] Add Kopi Toraja Beans to the cart and open Checkout
steps.expect: The Pay button shows Rp 110.000

steps.step: [UI] Fill a valid address and card 4242 4242 4242 4242, then select Pay
steps.expect: The page says "Thank you! Your order LS-... is confirmed." and the cart count is 0

cases.title: Empty required fields are reported

steps.step: [UI] Open Checkout with one item and clear the Full name field
steps.expect: The form shows

steps.step: [UI] Select Pay without filling the form
steps.expect: Each empty field shows "This field is required." and no order is created

cases.title: Declined card shows a payment error

steps.step: [UI] Fill Checkout with card 4000 0000 0000 0002 and select Pay
steps.expect: The alert says "The card was declined. Use another card."

steps.step: [UI] Open the cart
steps.expect: The item is still in the cart

cases.title: Invalid card number is rejected

steps.step: [UI] Fill Checkout with card 1234 5678 9012 3456 and select Pay
steps.expect: The Card number field shows "Enter a valid 16-digit card number."

cases.title: Expired card is rejected

steps.step: [UI] Fill Checkout with expiry 01/20 and select Pay
steps.expect: The Expiry field shows "This card has expired."

cases.title: Postal code must have exactly 5 digits

steps.step: [UI] Fill Checkout with postal code 4011 (4 digits) and select Pay
steps.expect: The Postal code field shows "Enter a 5-digit postal code." and no order is created

cases.title: A new order shows in My orders

steps.step: [UI] Place an order with the test card
steps.expect: The confirmation shows the order ID

steps.step: [UI] Open My orders
steps.expect: The list shows that order ID with status Paid

cases.title: A customer cannot open another customer's order

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as customer@demo.com and open order LS-10002 (it belongs to Rina)
steps.expect: The page shows "This order does not exist."

cases.title: Admin creates a product

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as admin and open Products > Add product
steps.expect: The Add product form shows

steps.step: [UI] Fill a qa-auto product and select Create product
steps.expect: The message says "Product created." and the list shows the new SKU

steps.step: [UI] Search the shop for the new product
steps.expect: The shop shows the new product

cases.title: Admin edits a product price

steps.step: [UI] Create a qa-auto product, then select Edit on its row
steps.expect: The Edit product form shows the current price

steps.step: [UI] Change the price to 175000 and save
steps.expect: The message says "Product updated." and the row shows Rp 175.000

cases.title: Admin deletes a product

steps.step: [UI] Create a qa-auto product, then select Delete on its row
steps.expect: A confirmation dialog asks to delete it

steps.step: [UI] Confirm the delete
steps.expect: The message says "Product deleted." and the row is gone

cases.title: Product form rejects invalid data

steps.step: [UI] Open Add product and submit an empty form
steps.expect: Name, SKU, Price and Stock show their errors

steps.step: [UI] Use the existing SKU LS-APP-001
steps.expect: The SKU field shows "This SKU is already used."

cases.title: A draft product is hidden from the shop

steps.step: [UI] Create a qa-auto product with status Draft
steps.expect: The admin list shows it with status draft

steps.step: [UI] Search the shop for it
steps.expect: The shop shows "No products match your search"

cases.title: A new customer order shows in admin Orders

steps.step: [UI] Place an order as a new qa-auto customer
steps.expect: The confirmation shows the order ID

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as admin and open Orders
steps.expect: The list shows that order with status Paid and the customer name

cases.title: Admin moves an order from Paid to Processing

steps.step: [UI] Place an order as a new qa-auto customer, then open admin Orders
steps.expect: The order row offers Processing and Cancelled

steps.step: [UI] Choose Processing
steps.expect: The message says the order is now Processing and the row shows Processing

cases.title: Cancelling an order puts the stock back

steps.step: [UI] Note the stock of Rattan Coaster Set in admin Products, then order 2 as a qa-auto customer
steps.expect: Admin Products shows the stock 2 lower

steps.step: [UI] Cancel the order in admin Orders
steps.expect: The row shows Cancelled and the stock is back to the first value

cases.title: A customer cannot open admin pages

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as customer@demo.com
steps.expect: The header has no Admin link

steps.step: [UI] Open the admin Users page by its address
steps.expect: The page says "You do not have access to this page"

cases.title: A disabled customer cannot sign in

steps.step: [UI] Register a qa-auto customer, then sign in as admin and open Users
steps.expect: The new user shows status active

steps.step: [UI] Select Disable and confirm
steps.expect: The row shows status disabled

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as the disabled customer
steps.expect: The alert says "This account is disabled. Contact support."

cases.title: Admin cannot change their own role or status

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as admin and open Users
steps.expect: The Demo Admin row has no role list and no Disable button

cases.title: Admin dashboard shows the KPIs

steps.step: [UI] Sign in as admin and open Dashboard
steps.expect: Revenue, Orders, Customers and Low stock items show numbers, and Recent orders lists 5 rows

cases.title: API: valid sign in returns a token

steps.step: [API] POST /api/auth/login with the demo admin account
steps.expect: HTTP 200, body has token and user.role admin

cases.title: API: wrong password returns 401

steps.step: [API] POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password
steps.expect: HTTP 401, error.code INVALID_CREDENTIALS

cases.title: API: product list returns 11 active products

steps.step: [API] GET /api/products
steps.expect: HTTP 200, total 11, no product with status draft

cases.title: API: out-of-stock product returns 409

steps.step: [API] POST /api/cart/items with productId p6 (Bucket Hat)
steps.expect: HTTP 409, error.code OUT_OF_STOCK

cases.title: API: declined card returns 402

steps.step: [API] POST /api/orders with card 4000000000000002
steps.expect: HTTP 402, error.code PAYMENT_DECLINED

cases.title: API: invalid status change returns 409

steps.step: [API] PATCH /api/admin/orders/LS-10001 with status Processing (order is Delivered)
steps.expect: HTTP 409, error.code INVALID_TRANSITION

cases.title: API: admin endpoint without a token returns 401

steps.step: [API] GET /api/admin/stats without a token
steps.expect: HTTP 401, error.code UNAUTHORIZED

cases.title: API: admin endpoint as a customer returns 403

steps.step: [API] GET /api/admin/stats with a customer token
steps.expect: HTTP 403, error.code FORBIDDEN

cases.title: API: admin cannot change their own role

steps.step: [API] PATCH /api/admin/users/u1 with role customer as the admin
steps.expect: HTTP 409, error.code SELF_CHANGE
